content: Theia's native modules (nsfw file watcher, native-keymap, keytar) are common node-gyp build-failure points: N-API/ThreadSafeFunction compile errors, missing prerequisites (Python, VS Build Tools+C++ workload on Windows), and corporate-proxy failures requiring manual node-gyp rebuild --proxy. Separately, Theia's electron and browser (Node.js) targets link against different native module ABIs and each target's native modules must be rebuilt separately (issue #5676) or the other target breaks.
